posts.text: The EV transition and BESS are the reality, and this shift is likely to accelerate faster than most currently expect. Ola is going through a struggling period, which is common among new-age companies, especially those still in the nascent stage of their lifecycle. posts.text: Mahashakti is expected to be based on prismatic LFP battery which is still under development. R&D is expected to be completed by Dec 2026. So he maybe right in a sense that Ola announced MoU before Prismatic cells are ready. I would also advise caution against such blogs as they are often based on individual limited research and knowledge. MoUs are an indicator of product acceptance in the market and also act as an anchor customer. For example if a company is building a chemical plant they will get some anchor customers who will Commit to the portion of installed capacity even before the plant…
